timing.summary: The old harness omits combined CHARBOUND and STRIPCC mapping on both versions. That same call pattern prevents it from reaching the relevant normalization path before and after the change.

claims.necessity_reason: The review established this target-coverage obligation; this turn compares its timing only.

before.requirement: Exercise mapping with CHARBOUND and STRIPCC together so a generated grapheme sentinel reaches the pre-change control-stripping path.
before.reason: The before version can generate a CHARBOUND sentinel and pass it to normalization, whose STRIPCC condition treats it as a control. The old harness never selects both flags in one mapping call.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Mapping passes its options through reencoding to normalization.
The unchanged option contract permits combining these flags.

after.requirement: Exercise mapping with CHARBOUND and STRIPCC together so generated grapheme sentinels reach the changed preservation and removal handling.
after.reason: The after version changes sentinel handling in the combined-flags path, but the old harness still never selects both flags in one mapping call.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Mapping passes its options through reencoding to normalization.
The unchanged option contract permits combining these flags.

claims.comparison_reason: The innermost unsatisfied condition is the harness’s fixed call pattern: direct STRIPCC normalization lacks CHARBOUND, and every CHARBOUND mapping call lacks STRIPCC. That constraint is identical on both sides; the source change alters behavior behind it.
